name: ToT/RAP vLLM backend restore
purpose: Restore the ToT/RAP OpenAI-compatible vLLM backend and multi-server launchers that had existed in prior session history but were absent from the current checkout. This enables future ToT/RAP acceleration through repo-owned vLLM servers without changing the search logic, official scoring, or token budget accounting.

commands.command: grep transcript/history for prior ToT/RAP vLLM implementation and compare current checkout
commands.purpose: Confirm the user memory was correct: prior history contained a ToT/RAP vLLM backend and multi-server launcher, but current checkout lacked them.

commands.purpose: Validate restored ToT/RAP backend code and CLI exposure.

commands.purpose: Exercise the vLLM request/parse/token-accounting paths without consuming GPU or requiring a live vLLM server.

provenance.history_source: conversation transcript contained the prior ToT/RAP vLLM backend/launcher implementation from the Reasoning Gym fast method run phase.
provenance.repo_basis: maitrix-org/llm-reasoners commit f94e5ac2cb9788c3d7d7dbf2173884ed4088e4b2 via local repo-port adapter.
provenance.direct_run_status_at_restore: Direct Transformers ToT/RAP reproduction was still running under results/reproduction_gpu0_3_20260620/hb2_tot_rap/full_grid_n64_gpu0_3 and was not interrupted. Snapshot: 774/1920 rows, bad_zero_budget=0.

decision.headline: ToT/RAP now has a restored backend switch for transformers versus vllm, OpenAI-compatible request support, request-worker batching for vLLM calls, and multi-server launchers that shard work over existing vLLM endpoints. The current direct full-grid run is left untouched.

gate_outcomes.number: Prior conversation history confirmed ToT/RAP vLLM backend and launchers had been implemented before but were absent in this checkout.
Local fake OpenAI-compatible server returned JSON that _query_json_backend and _query_json_batch_backend parsed successfully with nonzero token accounting.
No vLLM ToT/RAP full-grid was launched in this item because the direct GPU0-3 reproduction is currently running; changing roots/backends mid-run would mix evidence.

decision.next_step_routing: After the current direct ToT/RAP run either completes or is explicitly retired, start a separate vLLM root with scripts/launch_hb2_tot_rap_vllm_multi_server_detached.sh against repo-owned vLLM servers, then record it as a distinct backend comparison item.

rows.meaning: Original direct Transformers generation path; default for existing reproduction roots.
OpenAI-compatible vLLM request path with local tokenizer-based token accounting.
Threaded HTTP concurrency for vLLM action/value request batches.
Comma-separated vLLM server URLs assigned to shards by launch_hb2_tot_rap_vllm_multi_server.sh.

honesty.scope: This item restores code and launchers only; it does not claim a completed ToT/RAP vLLM full-grid result.
honesty.backend_isolation: Direct Transformers and vLLM rows must not be merged into the same result root because backend behavior and throughput are different.
honesty.not_launched_reason: The current direct ToT/RAP reproduction is actively running. Starting a vLLM replacement without explicitly retiring it would create ambiguous evidence and compete for GPUs.
honesty.token_accounting: The vLLM backend charges input and output tokens using the same local tokenizer counter used by the direct backend.
